prompt: List every Facebook URL format/pattern this tool supports for extracting IDs (posts, photos, videos, reels, groups, permalink.php, share links, pfbid, etc). Include example URLs and what part of each is extracted as the ID.
content:
# Facebook URL Formats Supported by the Scraper

Based on the documentation, here are the supported URL patterns:

## Directly Supported Formats

**Pages & Profiles:**
- Numeric paths: `https://www.facebook.com/[numeric-id]`
- Query parameter: `https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=[id]`
- Vanity handles: `https://www.facebook.com/[handle]` (publicly visible only)

**Posts:**
- Numeric post paths: `https://www.facebook.com/[id]/posts/[post-id]`
- Group post/permalink: `https://www.facebook.com/[id]/permalink/[post-id]`
- Story format: URLs with `story_fbid` parameter

**Photos:**
- Photo format: `https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=[id]`

**Videos & Reels:**
- Video paths: `https://www.facebook.com/[id]/videos/[video-id]`
- Reel paths: `https://www.facebook.com/reel/[reel-id]`
- Watch format: `https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=[id]`

**Groups & Events:**
- Groups: `https://www.facebook.com/groups/[numeric-id]`
- Events: `https://www.facebook.com/events/[numeric-id]`

## Not Extractable

Per the documentation: "Opaque `pfbid...` tokens, vanity groups/events, private objects, deleted links" return as unresolved. The tool "never guesses an ID"—it either resolves definitively or flags as unresolved rather than speculate.
